reading.title: The Wrong Stop
reading.intro_zh: 这篇延展阅读把 Lesson 73 的“路线、期待与现实、被可信成年人帮助、不要逃避规则”换到安全的学校参观场景。短文为原创故事，不复述逃学男孩的跨国路线，也不把搭便车或躲藏写成有趣行为。

source.title: National Center for Safe Routes to School
source.publisher: National Center for Safe Routes to School

passage: During a science museum trip, Nina's class was supposed to meet at the main entrance after lunch. Their teacher had drawn a simple route on the trip card and reminded everyone not to leave the group. Nina wanted to see the robot room one more time, but she did not ask permission. When a crowd moved past her, she followed the wrong group toward a side exit.

At first, Nina thought the exit would lead back to the bus, as she hoped it would. Instead, it opened beside a quiet service road behind the museum. In the meantime, her class had walked to the main entrance, and the bus monitor had begun checking names. Nina felt embarrassed, but she remembered the safety rule: do not hide, do not wander farther, and do not accept rides from strangers.

She went back inside and spoke to a uniformed museum guide at the information desk. The guide called Nina's teacher and stayed with her until a school staff member arrived. Nina was sent back to her group safely. Later, she explained that trying to evade a small rule had created a big problem. The route card was not a decoration; it was a way to keep everyone together.

questions.question: Where was Nina's class supposed to meet after lunch?
options: At the side exit behind the museum.
In the robot room.
At the main entrance.
On a service road near the bus.
questions.explanation_zh: 第一段说 Nina's class was supposed to meet at the main entrance after lunch。

questions.question: What went wrong with Nina's route?
options: She followed the wrong group toward a side exit.
She was sent to another city by train.
She hid inside a boat for the night.
She asked a stranger for a free ride.
questions.explanation_zh: 第一段结尾说 she followed the wrong group toward a side exit。

questions.question: What did Nina hope the exit would do?
options: It would take her to a cinema.
It would let her avoid all teachers.
It would lead to another museum.
It would lead back to the bus.
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段说 Nina thought the exit would lead back to the bus, as she hoped it would。

questions.question: How did Nina get safe help?
options: She wandered farther down the road.
She spoke to a uniformed museum guide at the information desk.
She got into a stranger's car.
She crossed a border alone.
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段说 she spoke to a uniformed museum guide at the information desk。

questions.question: What lesson did Nina learn?
options: A route card is only a decoration.
It is better to hide when you feel embarrassed.
Evading a small rule can create a big safety problem.
Students should accept rides from strangers if they are late.
questions.explanation_zh: 最后一段说 trying to evade a small rule had created a big problem，并说明 route card 是为了让大家在一起。

writing.intro_zh: 今天抓五个 Lesson 73 的讽刺路线句式：用 Children who ... are ... 定义一类人，用 is usually as far as ... get 写通常限度，用 while ...ing 写紧凑时间背景，用 in the meantime, ... had ... 写同时发生的变化，用 did not ..., as ... hoped it would, but ... 写期待和现实的反差。

patterns.title: Children who ... are ...
patterns.source: Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
patterns.focus_zh: 这个结构用 who 从句定义一类人，再说明作者对这类人的判断。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一类遵守或不遵守安全规则的学生，并给出一个合适判断。
patterns.sample: Students who follow the trip route are easier to keep safe.
patterns.tip_zh: who 后面说明是哪一类 students 或 children，主句再给出判断。

patterns.title: is usually as far as ... get
patterns.source: is usually as far as they get
patterns.focus_zh: 这个表达用来说明某人通常能做到的限度。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一个安全活动中普通计划通常最多到什么程度。
patterns.sample: The front gate is usually as far as lost students should get.
patterns.tip_zh: as far as 不一定只说距离，也可以说行动的限度。

patterns.title: while ...ing, ...
patterns.focus_zh: while 加 -ing 动词可以紧凑地说明某个动作发生时的背景。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写学生在参观或排队时发生了一个安全相关的小问题。
patterns.sample: While looking for the main entrance, Nina asked a guide for help.
patterns.tip_zh: while 后面的动词用 -ing，主句写真正发生的动作。

patterns.title: in the meantime, ... had ...
patterns.source: the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais
patterns.focus_zh: 这个结构写在一段时间里，另一件事已经发生了。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写你跟错队时，班级已经移动到了另一个地方。
patterns.sample: In the meantime, my class had moved to another museum entrance.
patterns.tip_zh: in the meantime 可以放句首；had done 表示更早已经发生。

patterns.title: did not ..., as ... hoped it would, but ...
patterns.source: did not take him into the centre of Paris as he hoped it would, but to Perpignan
patterns.focus_zh: 这个结构先写期待没有实现，再用 but 写真实结果。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写某条路线、车或门没有把你带到希望的地方，而是带到另一个安全但错误的地方。
patterns.sample: The side exit did not lead back to the bus as I hoped it would, but to a service road.
patterns.tip_zh: did not 后写期待动作，as I hoped it would 表示“如我所愿”，but 后写真实结果。
